unlock_route: Register for CTIS public-API access with EMA: the CTIS public website (https://euclinicaltrials.eu/) documents a public API whose search route is behind an AWS API Gateway authorizer. Request credentials through the EMA CTIS service desk / the 'CTIS for sponsors and authorities' contact route at https://euclinicaltrials.eu/contact/ ; there is no anonymous tier. Alternative with no credential: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (already used) and the EU CTR results summary on the CTIS public web pages.
